title: Make you Famous
lyrics: Lord we love to sing your praise
Fill us with you grace and mercy
May we ever glorify your name
King of kings and Lord of lords
You are the Lion you're the Lamb
El shadai the great I AM
You took us off a path of shame
Washed us in your holy blood
Now we sing you songs of love
Your mercy flows a sea of love
Word of God the Living Lamb
Lord we love to sing you praise
Fill us with you grace and mercy
May we ever glorify your name
